decisions.reason: As a burner component for radiant heaters, it builds directly on the firm's existing gas infrared heating knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and early results can be interpreted and used for improvement.

The electric infrared panel heater is related to the firm's infrared heating expertise but uses electric technology that is less close to its gas-based core, yet its own page signals the firm is actively assimilating market feedback.

The electric halogen infrared heater similarly extends into electric heating where the firm has less accumulated knowledge, but the dedicated page indicates ongoing learning and a lower immediate risk of withdrawal.

The industrial electric infrared hall heater benefits from the firm's industrial heating application knowledge even though it is electric, so absorptive capacity is moderate and the firm can likely improve it.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater leverages the firm's core gas infrared technology and is strategically important, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
